note: Upper bound on requests to disallowed www4.ti.ch paths made by GitHub Actions runs before the RFC 9309 fix (commit 099f416, pushed 2026-10-10T22:48:08Z), from the committed run snapshot (data/compliance/ci_runs_before_fix.json) and the documents each executed fetching step reads (python -m gegenprobe.compliance.ci_repeats).

arms-8b-p2.yml.why_zero: its 6 shard jobs fetch the 62 P2 documents, none of which is on www4.ti.ch

gguf-8b.yml.why_zero: steps selfcheck / diag / impl score committed token-id fixtures (tests/fixtures/gguf_*.json) and fetch only the model file and llama.cpp sources; the `arms` step, the only one that reads documents, was skipped in all runs before the fix

nightly-real.yml.why_zero: one network night: OPD exports, Bern's OGD tables and BE documents; no www4.ti.ch URL

upper_bound_total_note: the round-6 bound: every run of a workflow counted at the full per-invocation fetch of its definition (ci 96 x 43, arms-8b 6 x 261, arms-8b-par 2 x 387, fill 40, p6 147). It left out arms-8b-p2 and gguf-8b; both made no request to www4.ti.ch (workflows.*.why_zero), so it is an upper bound on downloads too, looser than upper_bound_downloads
pacing: net.py waits >= 1.2 s between two requests to the same host within one process (all threads); separate processes on separate runners do not coordinate, so at the peak above at most 8 requests could reach www4.ti.ch within any 1.2 s
not_in_bound: robots.txt reads (an allowed path) and requests made outside GitHub Actions (results/compliance/robots_audit_all.json, totals.project)
